'''2000 French National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in France on 2000. [[Julien Riviere]] won it. It is known from Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2904">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-european-continental-2001-i-am-not-ind2904/ european-continental-2001-i-am-not-in], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 28 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-european-continental-2001-i-am-not-ind2904/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2000
* '''Site:''' France
* '''Winner:''' [[Julien Riviere]]
